value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification of the entire Fourier spectrum of a canonical quadratic algebraic variety, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The explicit dual-cone criterion gives a canonical nullspace basis and the exact rank p^5 versus ambient p^6; unexpectedly the supported fraction is 1/p, unlike the analogous field cone where it approaches one. Its five-level integral spectrum is useful as a finite-ring harmonic invariant and for Cayley convolution, independently of any downstream theorem.
